description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of an old slavic village of log houses at the edge of a forest, made of logs, planks, thatch and wooden shingles, no stone houses and no tiled roofs, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the village arena where champions duel: a large oval log amphitheatre with a wooden gallery under a shingle roof on one side, open to the sky, a sand pit in the centre with two straw training dummies, a wide gate under a carved aurochs head with long horns, weapon racks with spears and axes by the gate, red and gold banners, two torches
